description: This source file implements PNG filter algorithms according to the PNG specification, providing functionality to unfilter PNG scanlines during PDF processing within the PdfSharp library.

classes.name: PngFilter
classes.description: A static class providing methods to perform PNG unfiltering algorithms, including implementations for various PNG filter types such as None, Sub, Up, Average, and Paeth.

methods.name: Unfilter
methods.description: Performs PNG unfiltering on input data based on the specified filter type, reconstructing the original scanline data from the filtered data.

methods.name: PaethPredictor
methods.description: Computes the Paeth predictor used in PNG filtering for estimating pixel values based on neighboring pixels.
